author: Jninth
body:
**For KBBQ** -Personal opinion but Mo ran gak isn't all that its hyped up to be for me. I personally enjoy Grams BBQ. Its an all you can eat and you can put your name down on the yelp app which is super convenient. They have 3 different AYCE menus/prices so you can definitely get a better bang for your buck there. Its across the street from the Hmart.

**For Tofu Soup**: **Kaju Soft Tofu**. I love the fish cake, cucumber, and kimchi here. Flavor is always consistent and delicious so I usually just get large side orders of sides for my fridge. Its right next to that Hmart also. If you aren't craving a huge bowl of tofu soup, they have a combo that you can get which has a smaller portion of tofu soup but also includes a protein like galbi, bulgogi, or spicy pork

Also if you visit that Hmart in garden grove, they also have a steaming station at the end of the vegetables section where they have steamed sweet potatoes in a paper bag. Super nice if you want a snack. Just open the door and take a bag. If its still cooking, it'll have a timer on the door.
